subject: Error using stan_lmer to estimate betas varying by group without intercepts (0 + beta | group)

messages.author: 75c6a044f911fefc
messages.subject: Error using stan_lmer to estimate betas varying by group without intercepts (0 + beta | group)
parts:
When I use lme4 syntax in stan_lmer to specify a model that estimates varying betas by group without varying intercepts by group:

try(students_regression_stan_lmer <- stan_lmer(post_test_with_treatment_effect ~ pre_test + treated + (0 + treated| class), 
                                  data = students_observed_data, cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 1000))

I receive this error:

## failed to create the sampler; sampling not done
"Error in new_CppObject_xp(fields$.module, fields$.pointer, ...) : 
  Exception thrown at line -1: []: accessing element out of range. index 251 out of range; expecting index to be between 1 and 250; index position = 1v
failed to create the sampler; sampling not done
Error in check_stanfit(stanfit) : 
  Invalid stanfit object produced please report bug

However the same syntax works with lmer:

students_regression3_lmer <- lmer(post_test_with_treatment_effect ~ pre_test + treated + (0 + treated| class), 
                                  data = students_observed_data)

And I can get estimated group level treatment effects:

                                               data = students_observed_data, cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 1000))

However I was wondering if there is a way for me to specify the common intercept and but varying beta model in stan_lmer.

Thanks for the help,
Steven

Code block to create example:

require(rstanarm)
require(lme4)

students <- data.frame(id = 1:(25*20), class = rep(1:20, 25)) #assigning students to class
class_pre_effects <- rnorm(20, 50, 10) #estimating class pre test intercepts
students <- merge(students, data.frame(class = 1:20, alpha_j = class_pre_effects), "class") #assigning intercepts to students
students$error_pre <- rnorm( 25*20, 0, 15) #adding student errors
students$pre_test <- students$alpha_j + students$error_pre #calculating student pre-test scores
students$post_test_pre_treatment <- 10 + 0.7 * students$pre_test + rnorm( 25*20, 0, 10) ##simulating post test scores before adding treatment effects
class_treatment_effects <- rnorm(20, 5, 5) ##calculating treatment effects
class_treatment_effects[1:10] <- 0  ##removing effects for control classes (1 to 10)
students <- merge(students, data.frame(class = 1:20, class_treatment_effects), "class") ##combining data and flagging treated classes
students$treated <- ifelse(students$class > 10, 1, 0)
students$post_test_with_treatment_effect <- students$post_test_pre_treatment + students$class_treatment_effects ##calculating post test scores with the treatment effect
students_observed_data <- students[ ,c("id", "class", "pre_test", "post_test_with_treatment_effect", "treated")] ##building a dataset with only 'observed' data

try(students_regression_stan_lmer <- stan_lmer(post_test_with_treatment_effect ~ pre_test + treated + (0 + treated| class), 
                                  data = students_observed_data, cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 1000))
try(print(students_regression_stan_lmer))
try(fixef(students_regression_stan_lmer))
try(ranef(students_regression_stan_lmer))

students_regression3_lmer <- lmer(post_test_with_treatment_effect ~ pre_test + treated + (0 + treated| class), 
                                  data = students_observed_data)

print(students_regression3_lmer)
fixef(students_regression3_lmer)
ranef(students_regression3_lmer)


try(students_regression_stan_lmer_ints <- stan_lmer(post_test_with_treatment_effect ~ pre_test + treated + (1 + treated| class), 
                                               data = students_observed_data, cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 1000))

print(students_regression_stan_lmer_ints)
fixef(students_regression_stan_lmer_ints)
ranef(students_regression_stan_lmer_ints)
